about: Map data for a browser RISK: Global Domination replica. One folder per upstream source; each carries its own LICENSE or licence note.
start_here: canonical/classic-world.json - the verified classic 42-territory graph (7 independent sources agree exactly).

graph_only_maps.warning: Tolkien place-names are Tolkien Estate IP - rename before shipping

reference_catalogue.has: territory + region counts, map pack, size bucket, blizzard/portal counts, per-region bonus values
reference_catalogue.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 wiki text; the numbers are facts

geometry_toolkit.naturalearth/: PUBLIC DOMAIN country + admin-1 polygons (build any region)
geometry_toolkit.topojson-atlas/: ISC TopoJSON world + US states (small, web-ready)
geometry_toolkit.wikimedia/BlankMap-World.svg: PUBLIC DOMAIN world SVG with per-country ISO ids
geometry_toolkit.country-borders/: CC BY-SA 4.0 country land-border pairs (auto-derive adjacency; attribution required)

cross_check_only.risk-neighborhood/: MIT but 3 known errors - do not ship
cross_check_only.conquest-tracker/: MIT, exact graph + x,y label points, crude continent blobs
cross_check_only.conquete/: MIT, exact graph + best rules engine

never_ship: Wikimedia Risk_board.svg / Risk_game_board.svg and the Risk board PNGs - traced from a retail Hasbro board
Lux Delux / Warzone / TripleA maps - no licence or proprietary
